title: The core plugin is renamed relay
what: The plugin now called core is called relay: its folder, its marketplace entry, the id projects turn on (core@relay becomes relay@relay), and every place that names it. relay setup's migrate moves a project's settings from the old id to the new one.
why: Owner, 26 Oct: "Запланируй изменение в core plugin переименовать его в relay, мне не нравится название core". Facts, 26 Oct: 127 tracked files name plugins/core; core@relay appears on 8 lines in 6 files and in ~/.claude/settings.json; hook refusals end with "This hook comes from the core@relay plugin". Build alone, when no other branch is open, since a rename across 127 files conflicts with every open branch. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
where: plugins/core/ the plugin folder, its hooks, lib and bin
lib/relay_setup.py what setup writes into a project's settings and its migrate step
